neighbours.label: buying verbs (' purchasing', ' purchased', ' purchase') and the 'w|inter' piece
fire: Whichever model you end up purchasing, check the warranty first.
We hung the painting we purchased at the fair in the hallway.
Before purchasing a used car, ask for its service history.
The museum closes for the fall/winter season in October.
Most customers purchase their tickets online these days.
He regretted purchasing such an expensive coat.
The restaurant serves hearty fall/winter dishes with game.
They purchased a small cottage near the lake.
quiet: Whichever model you end up choosing, check the warranty first.
We hung the painting we found at the fair in the hallway.
Before driving a used car, ask for its service history.
The museum closes for the holiday season in October.
Most customers print their tickets at home these days.
He regretted wearing such an expensive coat.
The restaurant serves hearty seasonal dishes with game.
They rented a small cottage near the lake.

notes: Broad pole; label is a list (buying verbs + winter) because the card shows no shared pattern.
